blocks.name: Before and after
blocks.description: Two pictures of the same thing split by a glowing line the visitor drags: smiles, rooms, gardens, cars, designs.

blocks.name: Contact form
blocks.description: A title, your details and a short form. Messages go to a form service, or open the visitor's email app addressed to you.

fields.label: Or post to a form service (https)
fields.hint: For example a Formspree or Basin endpoint. Wins over email.

defaults.title: Let's talk
defaults.body: Tell us a little about what you need and we will get back to you within a day.
defaults.thanksText: Your message is on its way. We will reply soon.
defaults.error: That did not go through. Please email us instead.

blocks.name: Counting numbers
blocks.description: A row of key numbers that count up from zero when they scroll into view.

blocks.name: Trailing cursor
blocks.description: A dot that trails the mouse and grows over anything clickable. Hidden on touch screens and for visitors who ask for less motion.

blocks.name: Giant gradient headline
blocks.description: A screen-filling headline whose last line glows in a three-colour gradient, rising in line by line.

fields.label: Headline (one line per row; the last glows)

defaults.body: A short line that says what you do and who it is for.

blocks.name: Picture with hotspots
blocks.description: A picture with pulsing pins placed anywhere on it. Each pin opens a short note: rooms, features, product parts, places on a map.

spots.title: The work table
spots.text: Where every project starts, with paper first.

spots.title: Natural light
spots.text: North-facing windows keep colours true all day.

spots.title: Plants
spots.text: Looked after by everyone, named by the newest person.

blocks.name: Picture reels
blocks.description: Two rows of pictures gliding in opposite directions, speeding up while the page scrolls.

blocks.name: Magnetic call to action
blocks.description: A large closing line and a pill button that is pulled towards the pointer.

blocks.name: Night valley
blocks.description: A full-screen 3D valley at night: thousands of swaying flowers and leaves, stars, light rays, bloom and grain, with your words over it.

defaults.title: A quiet place to begin
defaults.body: Slow down, look closer, and let the details lead the way.

blocks.name: Numbered services
blocks.description: A title and big numbered rows (services, steps, reasons) that slide in and lean towards the pointer.

items.title: Strategy
items.text: We start with your goals, your customers and what makes you different.

items.title: Design
items.text: A look and voice that people remember, made for every screen.

items.title: Build
items.text: Fast, accessible pages that are easy for you to keep up to date.

items.title: Grow
items.text: Measure what works, then do more of it.

blocks.name: Pricing plans
blocks.description: Plans or packages side by side, each with a price, what is included and a button. One can be picked out.

defaults.title: Simple pricing
defaults.body: Pick the plan that fits. Change or cancel any time.

plans.name: Growth
plans.features:
Ten projects
Priority support
Custom domain

blocks.name: Product cards
blocks.description: A bold title and bright coloured cards for products, menu items or packages, each tilting towards the pointer.

defaults.title:
Grab
a bag
defaults.body: Bold flavours, real ingredients. Pick your favourite or try them all.

blocks.name: Reading progress
blocks.description: A thin bar along the top, or a short track at the right, that fills as the visitor scrolls.

blocks.name: Scroll-driven film
blocks.description: A film pinned to the screen that plays as the visitor scrolls, forwards and backwards, with captions taking turns.

fields.label: Film (short, mp4)
fields.hint: Films with a keyframe every few frames scrub most smoothly.

defaults.captions:
It starts with an idea.
Then it takes shape.
And then it is yours.

blocks.name: Spotlight reveal
blocks.description: A full-width picture with a spotlight that follows the pointer and shows a second picture through it. Drifts by itself when nobody points.

defaults.title: Look a little closer
defaults.body: Move across the picture to see what lies underneath.

blocks.name: Stacking project cards
blocks.description: Large cards for projects, rooms, products or cases that stick and stack on top of each other as the page scrolls.

items.title: North Studio
items.text: A calm new identity and a website that books itself.

items.title: Stoneware
items.text: Launch film, product pages and a shop that tripled orders.

items.title: Harbour Lofts
items.text: A scroll story for twelve new homes by the water.

blocks.name: Word-by-word statement
blocks.description: A large statement whose words light up one by one as the visitor scrolls.

defaults.body: We are a small team that cares about the details. Every project starts with listening, and ends with something people are glad to use.

blocks.name: Live 3D world
blocks.description: A live 3D scene beside your words that visitors can drag to turn and scroll to zoom: glowing deep-sea flora, floating rings, liquid metal waves or sound rings.

fields.label: Visitors can turn and zoom it

defaults.title: Step inside
defaults.body: Drag to turn the scene, scroll to come closer.

media.label: Sheet with every bar and ingredient
